description.value:
Frequency once per Walking Through

Trigger Your Passage reaches the Cap during an encounter.

You hold it. Walking Through does not occur; it is delayed until the end of the current encounter, at which point it happens as normal. For the rest of the encounter you are at the Cap for every other purpose — every effect keyed to your Passage band applies at its highest — and you cannot lower your Passage or delay this again.

cinderfall.incomplete: Ashcantor's entire signature resource system (Passage, a Passing, Walking Through, Embers, Ash-Light) has zero rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus -- the class card itself (classes.ashcantor.json) ships system.rules: [], and no abilities/ or class-features/ card exists to hold a Passage/Ember mechanic either. Checked pf2e's own generic SpecialResource rule element (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/special-resource.ts:24-247) as a possible fit: every real user (Alchemist's Versatile Vials, Gunslinger's Munitions Machinist, Fumbus's iconic feats) is a daily-refilling consumable counter, never a one-way permanent-increase track like Passage -- no real class resource matches Passage's shape, so there is no base mechanic here to extend or modify. Specifically, this delays "Walking Through," the class's own capstone-of-the-resource event, which has no threshold field or SpecialResource entry to check against or delay.
